summary: social_fetch now actually reaches the host bridge: the bridge unit sets OPENCLI_BIN (the systemd user environment carries no interactive PATH, so the bare `opencli` spawn failed with FileNotFoundError) and binds the docker0 gateway (172.17.0.1) in addition to loopback, because Nora's container sits on the private compose `nora` network — not host networking — and reaches the host at host.docker.internal:19826. [social] bridge_url defaults/comments corrected to match.
details: nora/infra/social/__main__.py: NORA_SOCIAL_BRIDGE_HOST env (comma-separated bind addresses, default 127.0.0.1) — deployed value 127.0.0.1,172.17.0.1

docs corrected (deploy/social-bridge/README.md, docs/runbook.md §10, ARCHITECTURE.md, config.example.toml, SocialConfig docstring) — the bridge is loopback+docker0, never a LAN interface; the container calls host.docker.internal:19826
